integrity: The infinite-dimensional spectral assertions follow from the self-contained matrix, orthogonal-polynomial and exterior-power proof. Finite exact and high-precision numerical checks are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. The result has no independent audit.
limitations: Fixed order q at least three; unweighted unit disk; centered hard cutoff with fixed squared radius strictly between 0 and 1. No uniform parameter claims, off-center geometry, exact finite-degree cutoffs, or independently audited priority.
title: Factorial spectral stratification of compact-core concentration in polyanalytic Bergman spaces
